feature_family_descriptions.applicant_consistency: Cross-fitted, train-fold-only frequencies of four predeclared categorical applicant-profile pairs.
feature_family_descriptions.application_process: Raw missingness flags, fit-fold-vocabulary one-hot missingness profiles, and missingness-by-age/contract interactions.
feature_family_descriptions.external_disagreement: Availability-adjusted spread, standard deviation, median/range, and pairwise absolute differences among EXT_SOURCE_1..3.
feature_family_descriptions.financial_residuals: Cross-fitted, fold-local shrunk median residuals of log annuity and log goods price conditional on binned log credit and income.
feature_family_descriptions.low_score_expert: 50th-percentile score gate derived from inner OOF CatBoost scores; specialist fit uses only gated outer-fit rows.

interpretation: All candidates exploratory on historically exposed labels; bootstrap intervals are conditional on saved OOF vectors and do not account for training variability or prior selection.
